data.name: Unkillable
data.description: The vigilante gains Diehard as a bonus feat, though he does not have to meet the prerequisites for this feat.

raw_tokens.value: The vigilante gains Diehard as a bonus feat, though he does not have to meet the prerequisites for this feat.
He doesn't lose hit points when he takes a standard action while disabled.|PREVARGTEQ:VigilanteTalentLVL,6

When he would die from hit point damage, he remains alive for 1 round before dying (and if his hit points rise above a negative amount equal to his Constitution score before that round is over, he doesn't die).|PREVARGTEQ:VigilanteTalentLVL,12
He is no longer disabled at negative hit points and can take a full round's worth of actions.|PREVARGTEQ:VigilanteTalentLVL,18
